title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Portfolio Discount by the Reach of the Building's Automation Plan
content:
## Portfolio pricing note

The portfolio discount taken off the escalated figure of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements renewal follows the reach of the building automation service plan at the building, held under the Building Automation Service Plans. Two readings decide it: whether that plan stands in active status, and how many monitored points it covers.

| The building's automation service plan | Portfolio discount share taken off |
|---|---|
| stands in active status and covers 200 or more monitored points | the full portfolio discount share, 7 percent |
| stands in active status and covers fewer than 200 monitored points | the part portfolio discount share, 3 percent |
| the owner holds no building automation service plan in active status | no portfolio discount |

### Boundary

At exactly 200 monitored points the plan covers "200 or more", so the full portfolio discount share of 7 percent is taken off; at 199 monitored points the part share of 3 percent is taken off.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

An escalated figure of 6 000.00 USD has 420.00 USD taken off it where the building's automation plan is active over 240 monitored points, and 180.00 USD where that plan is active over 150 points. The status and the covered point count are read from the owner's Building Automation Service Plans records for the agreement's building.
